alternative.aliasRationale: Same advertised concept and route; separately retained source-authored concept-nav chooser label/selector, not another material concept.
alternative.meaning: B, Power-state selector: seven radial selector modules open into a teaching schedule; distinguishes a state schedule from physical observation and projected endurance from the observed run. Explicit teaching metaphor, not a device Ada built.
alternative.observationScope: One real non-idempotent starting concept for each distinct nav chooser. The same shared nav is rendered on all three concepts; this does not claim testing every ordered route pair.

1 / Scope · Concept B
What can a power-state schedule tell us—and what must we observe?

Ada Mensah · Embedded firmware

I wrote the Mosslink firmware, scheduled its power states and built its bring-up fixture.

Email Ada
Read the evidence

Power-state selector; original teaching mechanism, not a device Ada built.

2 / Transition · Concept B
A schedule meets the bench

The selector opens to distinguish a teaching state sequence from a physical observation. Sleep, Measure and Transmit are illustrative labels, with no claimed timings.

A current trace showed the radio remaining awake after a failed transmission. No cause, fix or later resolution is confirmed.

Two-year battery life: projection from bench currents and an assumed reporting cycle. Longest run: 72 hours. No field endurance or weather testing supports the projection.

Power-state selector; original teaching mechanism, not a device Ada built.

3 / Next action · Concept B
A model is only part of the answer

A firmware decision needs a physical observation. An estimate and an observed run support different claims.

Mosslink: forty engineering samples assembled; six bench-tested; none sent to customers. One preliminary emissions check passed; full qualification remains unfinished.
